method: Executed fills only. Buy value is cumulative gross turnover, not NAV weight. Full ledgers, not recent-trade samples. Recorded rounded fill prices used when gross is absent.

Darvas.fix: Exit floor excludes current candle: minimum of prior 20 observed closed-minute lows.

expansion.caveat: Early/late minute samples do NOT verify continuous full three-year minute history. Current listing is not point-in-time membership; 500–600 eligible symbols are not yet established.
steps: Audit real daily history of all stock candidates against the same 747-session calendar; do not fill gaps.
Download and validate full minute history only for daily-qualified candidates, recording missing sessions and price/corporate-action mismatches.
Freeze a separate 500–600-stock study if enough pass; retain the 146-stock baseline and paper ledgers.

For a less biased market test, use point-in-time eligibility, delisted stocks where available, historical liquidity screens, corporate actions and out-of-sample validation; more symbols alone do not ensure accuracy.
